products.name: Forma One
products.subtitle: Over-ear headphones · Chalk
products.alt: Ivory over-ear headphones on an oxblood studio background
products.description: Quiet by design. The Forma One brings an understated silhouette to everyday listening, with up to 40 hours of battery life documented in its product manual.

claims.label: Battery life
claims.passage: Battery life: up to 40 hours of playback with active noise cancellation disabled. Actual playback time varies by volume, codec, and usage.

claims.label: Connectivity
claims.passage: Wireless connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3. A wired connection is supported using the included audio cable.

claims.label: Finish
claims.passage: Chalk edition. Exterior yokes: anodized aluminum. Earpad covering: synthetic leather. Do not describe the full product as plastic-free.

products.draft: A quieter kind of everyday. Meet Forma One: considered over-ear headphones in Chalk, with Bluetooth 5.3 and up to 40 hours of playback with noise cancellation off. Made for the details you hear — and the ones you notice.

products.subtitle: Face serum · 30 mL

products.description: A considered addition to a daily routine. A 30 mL face serum presented in a green glass bottle. Formulation and care details remain connected to the source sheet.

claims.label: Volume
claims.passage: Net contents: 30 mL. Packaging: green glass bottle with a dropper dispenser. Recyclability depends on local collection and component separation.

claims.label: Use
claims.passage: For external use only. Patch test before first use. Discontinue if irritation occurs. No treatment or medical efficacy claim is supported by this source.

products.draft: A small, considered daily ritual. Verdant Daily is a 30 mL face serum in green glass. Explore the product's documented care instructions before making it part of your routine.

products.name: Arc Table Light

products.description: An architectural accent for a quieter corner. Brushed aluminum, a diffused light source, and a form that gives the everyday a little more intention.

claims.label: Material
claims.passage: Exterior shade and base: brushed aluminum. Product photographs depict the silver finish. Dimensions: 32 cm high, 24 cm shade diameter.

products.draft: An object, and a little atmosphere. Arc Table Light pairs brushed aluminum with a sculptural silhouette, bringing a considered accent to your indoor space. Powered by USB-C, 5 V.
